literal_delay.stop_activation: first observed bar after entry bar
literal_delay.entry: next observed bar open after source signal
literal_delay.market_exit: next observed bar open; priority over stop at that open
literal_delay.stop: entry fill price +/- source distance; adverse gap open, otherwise stop level
literal_delay.volume: Grid24.v as total Ticks under Build Volume On=Trade Volume
literal_delay.atr: mean prior 20 exact-15:00 completed RTH high-low ranges
literal_delay.source_history: all observed finite OHLC bars, across dates, without account eligibility filtering
literal_delay.source_vwap_zero: retain previous sessVWAP if current cumulative Ticks=0
literal_delay.current_night_os_guard: none: classified only validates prior history; short current nights can select OS
literal_delay.account_coverage: finite OHLC for each minute 08:29..11:00 inclusive; no missing held range or cross-date carry
literal_delay.costs: raw price geometry only; fees and fill slippage applied by account/diagnostics caller
literal_delay.account_failsafe: none invented: source carries and unclosed trades are audited/excluded
literal_delay.price_levels: adverse .25-point rounding: sell stop down, buy stop up; disclosed source benchmark adapter
